segments.tha-ap423:1.3: Disvāva taṃ pādapaggaṃ, tattha cittaṃ pasādayiṃ.
segments.tha-ap423:2.3: Sammajjitvāna taṃ bodhiṃ, avandiṃ pāṭaliṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap423:3.3: Namassamāno taṃ bodhiṃ, gañchiṃ paṭikuṭiṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap423:5.1: “Āsanne me kataṃ kammaṃ, phalena tosayī mamaṃ;
segments.tha-ap423:7.3: Daddu kaṇḍu ca me natthi, phalaṃ sammajjanāyidaṃ [sammajjane idaṃ (sī.)].
segments.tha-ap423:8.1: “Soko ca paridevo ca, hadaye me na vijjati;
segments.tha-ap423:9.1: “Samādhīsu na majjāmi [samādhīsu na sajjāmi (sī.), samādhiṃ puna pajjāmi (syā)], visadaṃ hoti mānasaṃ;
segments.tha-ap423:9.3: Yaṃ yaṃ samādhimicchāmi, so so sampajjate mamaṃ.
segments.tha-ap423:10.1: “Rajanīye na rajjāmi, atho dussaniyesu [dosaniyesu (sī. syā. ka.)] ca;
segments.tha-ap423:11.1: “Ekanavutito [ekanavute ito (sī. syā.)] kappe, yaṃ kammamakariṃ tadā;
segments.tha-ap423:13.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi, mama buddhassa santike;
segments.tha-ap423:13.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap423:15.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā sakiṃsammajjako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
